shapes.name: Rounded Rectangle 25
text: THE MASSIVE CRISIS: ONLY 1 IN 5 VICTIMS REACH CARE IN THE GOLDEN HOUR

• Blind Transit & Delays: Over 150,000 annual ambulance deaths occur due to uncoordinated hospital selection and fatal admission delays. • Read-Only Static Portals: Current state dashboards show what existed hours ago — reading a portal is NOT reserving a bed. • Ghost Bed Paradox: Portals display raw physical frames while hiding that zero on-duty nurses are present to staff ICU beds.

shapes.name: Rounded Rectangle 27
text: OUR SOLUTION• Situational First-Aid: Gives bystanders live, step-by-step guidance (Semi-Fowler 45°, 300mg aspirin) en route to halt early collapse. • Route to nearest hospital: Our app shows you the nearest hospital with specific beds or blood and helps reserve bed/blood for You.• Zero-Signup Instant Access: Web PWA loads in <0.8s on any smartphone browser with zero app download or password barrier. • Staffed Bed Reservation: Strictly computes usable beds as Staffed Beds = min(Physical Beds, Nurses × Ratio) with dynamic GPS lock. • Instant Vernacular Triage: Categorizes acuity (ESI-1 to ESI-5) via voice in Bengali, Hinglish, or English with zero cloud latency.

shapes.name: Rounded Rectangle 29
text: Competitor Research and Uniqueness• vs. State Portals (e-RaktKosh ): They show static unverified "Ghost Beds" with no booking lock. ASHA executes atomic row-level bed locks. • vs. AI Chatbots (XparkAI / iRelief): Chatbots suffer high LLM latency and clinical errors. ASHA provides deterministic <0.8s instant routing. • vs. 108 Telephonic Dispatch: Call centers suffer 1-5 minute phone queues. ASHA automates sub-second routing with live WebSocket ER sync.

shapes.name: TextBox 25
text: TECHNICAL APPROACH & SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE
Sub-Second Resuscitation Pipeline • WebSockets & Road Snapping with Zero Cloud AI Latency

shapes.name: Rounded Rectangle 26
text: SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE LAYERS & CORE TECHNOLOGIES
▪ Citizen Web Client: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite. Zero-install responsive PWA optimized for low-end smartphones. Native W3C Web Speech API with 2.2s silence debounce.
▪ In-Memory Bengali Medical Engine: Client-side deterministic tokenizer mapping 150+ Bengali phrases to English clinical terms in 0ms without external LLM API costs or cloud latency.

▪ Triage Acuity Detection Engine: Standardized ESI-1 to ESI-5 triage detection system. Does not diagnose or medically judge patients; strictly categorizes resource acuity to route to equipped wards without LLM hallucinations.
▪ Open Source Routing Machine (OSRM): Self-hosted C++ routing engine with 1.35x Indian road winding factor, sub-second route calculation (<420ms), bypassing Google Maps API fees.
▪ Real-Time Cloud Synchronization: Supabase PostgreSQL WAL change-data-capture broadcasting live hold events across citizen and ER desk in <50 milliseconds over WebSockets.

shapes.name: Rounded Rectangle 25
text: CLINICAL & SOCIAL IMPACT: SAVING 15,000+ LIVES ANNUALLY

▪ Transforming 1-in-5 Golden Hour Survival: Currently only 1 in 5 Indian emergency victims reach care in time. ASHA eliminates blind emergency turnaways, giving families the highest probability of securing an available bed on their first run.
▪ Bridging the En-Route Care Void: Empowers families with AIIMS/ERC-validated first-aid steps, actively preserving cerebral and cardiac perfusion before hospital arrival.
▪ Ending Predatory Ambulance Touts: Prevents middlemen from diverting patients to unequipped nursing homes based on referral kickbacks.
▪ Equitable Regional Bed Balancing: Diverts cases from saturated medical colleges (140% load) to secondary hospitals with idle staffed beds.

shapes.name: Rounded Rectangle 27
text: HOSPITAL ER COMMAND DESK: REAL-TIME SYNC ACROSS 10 HOSPITALS
✔ Live WebSocket Queue (<50ms Latency): Supabase PostgreSQL WAL broadcasts incoming holds instantly with audio klaxon siren and flashing visual banner.
✔ 1-Tap Nurse Shift Counter & Dynamic Allocation: Nurses tap +/- on active nurses; beds dynamically recompute (normal beds shed first, 1:2 ICU stretch active in low staff).

✔ 100m Geofenced 4-Digit OTP Admission (<2s): Triage nurse inputs citizen's 4-digit OTP; backend strictly validates that patient's phone is within 100m of ER gate before converting to permanent hard-lock!

✔ Automated Cancellation & Re-Routing: If an ER bed becomes compromised, 1-tap admin cancel instantly re-routes patient to next optimal hospital, auto-updating citizen banner with new hospital address and fresh 4-digit OTP.
